title: Dot the Dog
note: b381 — Dot is a PROP creature (kit.PROPS.dog), not CAST, per the b381 brief.

pages.brief: Pip the sparrow perched on a fence post next to an enormous soppy brown dog with a white patch over one eye — Dot. The size difference is the whole joke. Bright, friendly.
pages.alt: Pip the small sparrow perches on a fence post beside Dot, an enormous soppy brown dog with a white patch over one eye — the size difference between them is the whole joke.

pages.brief: Dot sitting square on the grass in the classic obedient-dog pose, tail sweeping a fan-shape in the daisies, tongue out. Simple and full of character.
pages.alt: Dot the dog sits square on the grass in the classic obedient pose, tail sweeping a fan-shape through the daisies, tongue out.

pages.brief: Dot squashed onto a small stripy doormat far too little for her, paws hanging off all four sides. Pip watching from the doorstep, unimpressed.
pages.alt: Dot is squashed onto a small stripy doormat far too little for her, paws hanging off every side, while Pip watches from the doorstep looking thoroughly unimpressed.

pages.brief: Pip standing on Dot's broad head patting her between the ears with one wing. Dot's eyes are shut in absolute bliss. Warm and tender.
pages.alt: Pip stands on Dot's broad head, patting her gently between the ears with one wing, while Dot's eyes are shut tight in absolute bliss.

pages.brief: Dot digging furiously, back end up, earth flying in an arc behind her, a growing hole in the flowerbed. Pip leaping clear of the flying soil.
pages.alt: Dot digs furiously with her back end in the air, earth flying in an arc behind her out of a growing hole, while Pip leaps clear of the flying soil.

pages.brief: Closing page: Dot asleep in the sunny hole she dug, Pip asleep on her side, both rising and falling together. Late golden light, deep contentment.
pages.alt: Dot is fast asleep in the sunny hole she dug, with Pip asleep against her side, both rising and falling together in the late golden light.
